title: Start coding day skill

title: Status summary skill

title: Finish previous work skill

description: Define the normal Codex development loop for this project.

description: Create a Codex skill that opens a pull request to main.

title: Project memory curator skill
description: Create a Codex skill for durable project memory and notes hygiene.

title: Skill report skill

title: Backlog item metadata
description: Improve the backlog structure so each item can carry planning and ownership metadata.

title: Build three-page website structure

title: Confirm reboot baseline
description: Establish the current website baseline after the folder reboot.

title: Editable backlog page with persisted data
